title: CERN 全球 LHC 運算網格
subcategoryTitle: 高效能運算與世界級超算
summary: 以分層科學資料處理與跨機構計算串連 16 個原創技術單元、32 步；涵蓋原理解析、架構圖、假想量化、合成資料實驗、競爭失效原因及可重算驗收。
summaryEn: Sixteen original technical units and 32 tasks connect tiered scientific processing and interinstitutional computing with principles, architectures, assumed calculations, synthetic experiments, competing failure causes and reproducible acceptance.
scope: 公開原理的本地科教模擬與工程判讀。只使用自製、合成或明確授權的資料；不操作真實受害主機、他人帳號、工業控制或超算設施。數值不代表廠商規格或實測效能，完成課程不是專業資格、真實裝置操作經歷或生產部署認證。
scopeEn: Local educational simulation and engineering interpretation of public principles. Use self-made, synthetic or explicitly licensed data only; do not operate real victim hosts, other accounts, industrial control or supercomputing facilities. Values are not product specifications or measured performance. Completion is not a qualification, real-equipment experience or production-deployment certification.

stages.title: 實驗與資料
stages.description: 四個技術單元依序完成「實驗與資料」的架構與證據，共八步可分別儲存的本地科教實作。
stages.descriptionEn: Four technical units develop experiments and data through eight separately saved local educational tasks.

steps.title: 科學鏈路：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「科學鏈路」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for scientific chains.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「科學鏈路」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for scientific chains. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Final plots contain all raw experimental data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「科學鏈路」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for scientific chains; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.

knowledge.title: 原理與架構依據
knowledge.text: 探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。
knowledge.textEn: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts.

knowledge.title: 辨別模型的證據
knowledge.text: 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。
knowledge.textEn: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Preserve baselines, input versions, units and errors; this evidence supports stated model boundaries, not an automatic guarantee for an entire real system.

knowledge.title: 本課量化算例
knowledge.text: 假想 1 PB 十進位資料需經穩定 10 Gbit/s 鏈路傳輸，理想下限 10¹⁵×8/10¹⁰=800000 s，約 9.26 天。協議、排隊、故障與複製會增加時間；不代表 WLCG 實際資料率。
knowledge.textEn: One synthetic decimal PB over a sustained 10-Gbit/s link has ideal minimum 800,000 s or 9.26 days. Protocols, queues, failures and replication add time; this is not an actual WLCG data rate.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「CERN 全球 LHC 運算網格」的「科學鏈路：原理與架構」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Scientific chains: principles and architecture” in “CERN Worldwide LHC Computing Grid”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「科學鏈路」的原理與架構時，哪個說法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which principle/architecture claim is justified for scientific chains?
options: 最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。
探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。
只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「科學鏈路」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
optionsEn: Final plots contain all raw experimental data.
Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts.
One matching output proves scientific chains for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
quiz.explanation: 探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 因此「最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts. Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. The alternative "Final plots contain all raw experimental data." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 科學鏈路：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「科學鏈路」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for scientific chains.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。」；將結果與「探測器資料、重建與分析有不同產物。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Compare results against: Detector data, reconstruction and analysis produce different artifacts. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 畫玩具事件從原始到摘要的路徑。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Trace toy events from raw data to summaries. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Final plots contain all raw experimental data. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「科學鏈路」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for scientific chains; explain why this claim fails: Final plots contain all raw experimental data.

options: 最終圖表就是全部原始實驗資料。

steps.title: 事件身份：原理與架構

Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Events and dataset versions need stable traceability. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Assign IDs and processing versions to self-made events. 只要一次輸出符合預期，就能推定「公開邊界」對所有資料量、版本與故障條件都成立。
開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。
optionsEn: Scientific collaboration makes all data public.
One matching output proves public boundaries for all sizes, versions and failure conditions.
Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions.
quiz.explanation: 開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。 因此「科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。」混淆了本單元必須分開檢查的條件。
quiz.explanationEn: Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions. Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. The alternative "Scientific collaboration makes all data public." conflates conditions that must be checked separately.

steps.title: 公開邊界：實驗與證據
steps.objective: 以「公開邊界」建立可重算實驗、錯誤辨識與驗收證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Build reproducible experiments, diagnosis and acceptance evidence for public boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意後，僅在自製資料、副本或本地合成環境驗證，不連線真實目標、不取得旁人資料。實作：「只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。」；將結果與「開放科教資料與合作內部資料許可權不同。」逐項對照。保留基準和變更後輸出，先列至少兩個可能造成差異的原因，再用版本、單位、誤差或信任邊界排除其中一項。未有實測的數值須明寫為假想值。最後寫出透過／保留的理由和仍待驗證條件。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit, then validate only self-made data, copies or a local synthetic environment; do not connect to real targets or collect other people's data. Exercise: Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. Compare results against: Open educational and internal collaboration data have different permissions. Preserve baseline and changed outputs. List at least two competing causes and discriminate one using versions, units, errors or trust boundaries. Label unmeasured values hypothetical. Document pass/hold reasons and remaining conditions.
steps.observation: 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Scientific collaboration makes all data public. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「公開邊界」實驗輸出、基準差異、誤判排除與限用條件；解釋「科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。」為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: Submit outputs, baseline differences, rejected misconceptions and limits for public boundaries; explain why this claim fails: Scientific collaboration makes all data public.

knowledge.text: 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。 保留基準、輸入版本、單位與誤差範圍；這項證據只支援已列出的模型邊界，不能自動推廣為整套真實系統保證。

quiz.questionEn: Which validation approach is justified for public boundaries?
options: 只以自行生成或明確開放資料做練習。
科學合作存在就表示所有資料可公開。
先把「公開邊界」的顯示結果調到符合預期，再把這次吻合當作獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Practice only with self-generated or explicitly open data.
Scientific collaboration makes all data public.
Tune the displayed public boundaries result to the expected value and count that agreement as independent validation.

steps.title: 探測器校正：原理與架構
steps.objective: 以「探測器校正」建立原理、介面與可反駁模型。
steps.objectiveEn: Build principles, interfaces and a falsifiable model for detector calibration.
steps.instruction: 先觀察師傅的「探測器校正」示意，依序辨認輸入、狀態、輸出與信任或數值邊界，再在學徒工作臺排出資料／元件路徑。原理：重建輸出依賴校正與條件資料。 使用自行生成的小資料、紙上圖或本地玩具程式建立基準與一項受控變更；先寫下可觀察預測，再設計「讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。」的驗證。記錄單位、版本、假設與未知量，不把示意模型當真實裝置或服務。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor demonstration for detector calibration. Identify inputs, state, outputs and trust/numerical boundaries, then arrange the data/component flow in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Reconstruction depends on calibration and conditions data. Use self-generated small data, paper diagrams or a local toy program to create a baseline and one controlled change. State an observable prediction before planning this check: Compare one toy event under two calibrations. Record units, versions, assumptions and unknowns; the model is not real equipment or service.
steps.observation: 讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。 核對上述原理的適用範圍並記錄不符合預期之處。
steps.observationEn: Compare one toy event under two calibrations. Check the scope of the stated principle and record departures from expectations.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：原始資料不變就保證重建結果不變。 應檢查資料版本、單位、信任邊界與可區分原因的證據。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Unchanged raw data guarantees unchanged reconstruction. Check versions, units, trust boundaries and discriminating evidence.
steps.check: 提交「探測器校正」兩情境架構圖、假設與可反駁預測，並說明「讓同一玩具事件用兩套校正比較。」如何辨別它們。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case architecture, assumptions and falsifiable prediction for detector calibration; explain how the proposed evidence discriminates the cases.
